facts.fact: The Registration of Persons Act, 2015 (Chapter 332), an Act of Parliament assented to 26 March 2015, commenced that day for most Parts and on 1 January 2016 for Parts V and VI; it sets up the National Identification and Registration Authority, the National Identification Register and national identification cards.

The Registration of Persons Act, 2015 gives the Authority the function of creating the National Identification Register and assigning a unique national identification number to every person registered, and defines identity data to include biometric information and fingerprints.
